#1
संन्यासं|saṃnyāsam|saṃnyāsa — renunciation (acc. sg. neut., object of śaṃsasi)
कर्मणां|karmaṇām|karman — action (gen. pl. 'of actions')
कृष्ण|kṛṣṇa|Kṛṣṇa — Kṛṣṇa, Arjuna's charioteer and interlocutor (vocative)
पुनर्योगं|punar yogam|punar — again (adverb);;yoga — yoga (acc. sg., object of śaṃsasi, parallel to saṃnyāsam)
च|ca|ca — and
शंससि|śaṃsasi|śaṃs — to praise, proclaim, declare (śaṃsasi: present 2nd sg. 'you praise, proclaim')
--
यच्छ्रेय|yat śreyaḥ|yad — which (yat: nom. sg. neut. relative);;śreyas — better, more excellent (comparative; śreyaḥ: nom. sg. neut., predicate; yat + ś- → yac ch-)
एतयोरेकं|etayoḥ ekam|etad — this (etayoḥ: gen. dual 'of these two');;eka — one (ekam: nom. sg. neut., 'the one [that is better]'; etayoḥ + e- → etayor e-)
तन्मे|tat me|tad — that (tat: acc. sg. neut., object of brūhi; -t + m- → -n m-);;aham — I (me: enclitic dat. sg. 'to me')
ब्रूहि|brūhi|brū — to speak, tell (brūhi: imperative 2nd sg. 'tell!')
सुनिश्चितम्|suniścitam|su — well, thoroughly (prefix);;ni-ci — to ascertain, determine (niścita: past participle 'ascertained, determined', su-niścita: 'well-ascertained, decisively', acc. sg. neut., adverbial predicate to tat)
#2
